[00:00] [Ada] The public workshop is on 12 November. The proposal to finish the accessibility report by then is unrealistic.
[00:10] [Noah] I will write the accessibility report. I cannot commit to a deadline until the participants reply.
[00:20] [Ada] Agreed. Put Noah as the owner, and leave the report deadline unspecified.
[00:30] [Sam] I already sent the invitation yesterday. That is completed work, not a new action.
[00:40] [Ada] There is no approval to publish the report yet. We must obtain the participants' consent first.
[00:50] [Noah] Whether we can share an anonymized version is still unresolved.
